messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty -> SEV2: us-west1 GPU queue growth > 150k, autoscaler failures detected. Alerting oncall.
anya: I’m on it — looking at grafana now (link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/queues/us-west1).
omar: seeing sustained backlog & token throttle spikes, a lot of 429s from gateway.
mei: autoscaler API calls returning 403 quota_exceeded on project redwood-prod-usw1, likely reached cloud quota for GPUs.
carla: customer-facing: some customers report slow responses, one enterprise showing 5xx for batch jobs. CS notified?
cs-notify-bot: Notifying customer-success for impacted tenants: tenant-alpha, tenant-gamma, tenant-voyager.
anya: logs:
```
Autoscaler request failed: googleapiclient.errors.HttpError 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project
kubectl events -n rw-serving shows ImagePullBackOff on node bootstrap pods
```
ben: quick summary: two failure modes — cloud quota stop & image pull flaps. Both prevent new capacity. Queue keeps growing, router is throttling to protect runtime.
anya: mitigations I'm starting: 1) enable forced-fallback routing for critical routes to eu-west1 standby, 2) reduce non-critical batch priority to throttle downing, 3) open provider support ticket for quota bump.
omar: to enable fallback: runbook says toggle route-policy:priority-overflow -> fallback:eu-west1. Command:
```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane/api/v1/routing/policies/force-fallback" -d '{"from":"us-west1","to":"eu-west1","routes":["/v1/generate/high-priority"]}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN"
```
anya: executed force-fallback for /v1/generate/high-priority — verified low-volume hits now going to eu-west1 (logs show 200s). :white_check_mark:
mei: attempted to scale up nodepool with `gcloud container node-pools create --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=4` — gov cloud returned quota error. Opening escalation.
carla: CS update drafted: "We’re seeing degraded performance in us-west1 due to capacity provisioning errors. High-priority requests are being routed to eu-west1; non-critical jobs are being delayed. We’ll follow up with timeline and mitigation steps." Sending now.
ben: monitoring: queue length fell slightly from 156k -> 98k after fallback but throttling still in effect for unhandled routes. We need a longer-term capacity solution.
anya: temporary patch: turning on prefix-caching for small completions to reduce token load (config flip). Command:
```
POST /admin/cache/config {"prefix_cache_enabled": true, "max_prefix_tokens": 128}
```
mei: imagepull issue root cause: new bootstrap image tagged `latest` not present in us-west1 mirror; registry replication failed. Kicking a replication retry.
omar: rolling restart of bootstrap jobs to pick up mirrored image in us-west1. Command: `kubectl rollout restart -n rw-bootstrap deployment/bootstrap`
carla: are we paging oncall-shadow in eu-west1 infra team? Might need help warming warm-pool.
anya: yes paging eu-west infra. @ben can you coordinate with them for quick warm-pool expansion?
ben: pinged eu-west infra, they can add 8 GPUs from warm pool in ~12m. Allocating to high-priority.
incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff in 30m -> anya -> omar (night shift).
anya: taking handoff notes: actions completed: forced fallback enabled, prefix cache enabled, bootstrap replicate retried, CS notified, provider ticket opened. Remaining: provider quota increase, warm-pool add, postmortem.
omar: I’ll take over in 30m and monitor queue and routing metrics. If queue > 120k after warm-pool add and provider resolution in 45m, escalate to SEV1.
mei: provider support replied — submitted quota request, ETA 2-4 hours. They asked for usage history which I posted.
carla: Customer-impact quick calc: ~22 customers saw latency > 5s spikes, 3 enterprise tenants saw 5xx for ~18 minutes during peak. No data exfiltration.
ben: temp mitigation verdict: fallback + warm-pool brought p95 lat back to acceptable for high-priority traffic. Non-critical backfills still delayed.
anya: adding follow-ups: assign postmortem owner (mei), SOC/Compliance check (carla), infra quota plan (ben).
carla: creating incident ticket IT-9832 and notifying account managers for enterprise tenants.
incident-bot: Link to incident runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/incidents/gpu-capacity-exhaustion — follow for postmortem template.
anya: quick note for postmortem: action items: pin bootstrap images to immutable tags, add replica verification job, add automated fallback test in chaos suite, quota forecasting alerting.
omar: night handover: I’ll post status update in #oncall-summary after warm pool completes. Good handoff. :thumbsup:
carla: thanks all — let’s not forget to update customers once quota is fixed.
ben: marking this thread for follow-up review tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (routing fallback + warm-pool) at 1802507052. Postmortem required.
